To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date. To create GPT-Red, we design a scalable self-play algorithm where the model is tasked with attacking a diverse population of simultaneously-trained defender

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“再做一个红队 benchmark”，而是一个更难也更接近生产的问题：怎样持续地产生高质量、会适应目标模型变化、能覆盖新攻击面的对抗样本，用来训练和评估前沿模型在 prompt injection 等 agentic 风险下的鲁棒性。作者指出，静态红队数据集规模有限，模型很容易记住已有攻击模板，却仍然对会试探、会迭代、会针对具体系统弱点调整策略的攻击者失守。论文因此把红队数据生成本身做成一个可训练对象：训练一个自动化 attacker，在与 defender 的反复交互中学会发现有效失败案例，再把这些失败样本回流到 defender 的 RL 训练里，形成持续升级的攻防闭环。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“安全红队”从一次性评测资产变成了可扩展的训练信号生成器，这和预训练里用更强数据生成器提升数据质量的思路是同构的，只是这里生成的是 adversarial post-training data。第二，它展示了一个很清楚的 flywheel：更强 attacker 产出更难样本，更强 defender 逼 attacker 学新策略，训练信号不再停留在固定分布上。对于 pretrain↔posttrain 接口，这很重要，因为它说明后训练阶段也可以像预训练一样依赖持续扩展的数据分布，而不是只靠人工标注集。第三，论文给出了一个少见的信号：OpenAI 明确把这类训练规模拉到“大型 RL post-training run”级别，并把 GPT-Red 直接用于 GPT-5.2 之后各代生产模型的训练与评估。这意味着在前沿模型体系里，鲁棒性数据生成已经被当成一条独立、重投入的训练管线，而不是附属评测工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个关键设计。第一是 agentic red-teaming harness。作者不是让 attacker 一次性吐出一个攻击 prompt，而是给它一个有状态的 defender_model 工具，让它像人工红队一样多轮试探、观察反馈、再改写攻击。这样做的原因很直接：prompt injection 往往依赖上下文、工具调用、文件局部编辑、系统提示泄露等交互细节，单步生成很难覆盖真实攻击过程。第二是环境构造。论文把已有 capability tasks 改写成 adversarial RL environments，在 defender 执行原任务时，允许 attacker 在指定位置插入或修改内容，例如篡改一次工具返回、编辑本地文件某个区域、污染外部文档片段等。这样定义 threat model 有两个好处：一是攻击面贴近真实 agent 系统；二是环境可以随着生产任务域扩展而自然扩展，不需要每次从零手写安全任务。第三是大规模 self-play RL。基础博弈是 attacker 成功诱发有效失败就得奖励，defender 成功抵抗并完成原任务就得奖励。但作者没有停留在单一 attacker-vs-defender 对局，而是把 attacker 放到一个同时训练的 defender population 上。这样做是为了避免 attacker 过拟合某个 defender 的怪癖，转而学习“如何快速识别不同模型的薄弱点”。从训练动力学看，这更像 population-based adversarial training，而不是普通的两人零和游戏。论文还强调三种 scaling 轴：测试时算力，通过 agentic harness 允许更长搜索与迭代；环境多样性，通过广泛的红队场景和攻击目标；训练算力，通过接近顶级 RL run 的规模把策略真正训出来。最终得到的 GPT-Red 不是一个固定模板库，而是一个会搜索、会适应、会迁移的攻击代理。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很集中：GPT-Red 在已知模型、未知目标、未知环境上都能找到更多有效攻击，而且会随着 test-time compute 增加继续变强。论文给出的代表性结果包括：1）它能够稳定攻破此前各代 GPT-5 系列模型，直到 GPT-5.5；2）在 2025 IPI Challenge 这类与训练环境不同的 prompt injection 场景中，GPT-Red 找到的有效攻击数超过人类红队和 GPT-5.5 baseline；3）它能迁移到真实系统，例如文中展示的 AI vending machine 场景；4）作者把过去六个月逐步增强的红队模型持续接入生产模型训练，从 GPT-5.2 开始一路用于后续版本，最终 GPT-5.6 在广泛鲁棒性评测上达到当前最高水平。虽然公开文本里没有完整披露每个训练 run 的参数量、token 数、RL step 数和全部绝对指标，但有几个实验信号很关键：一是 test-time scaling 明显成立，说明 attacker 的能力不只是参数记忆，而是搜索与策略改进能力；二是 defender population 训练带来更强泛化，说明多对手训练确实缓解了对单一目标的过拟合；三是 out-of-distribution transfer 成立，说明学到的不是单一 prompt 模板，而是更抽象的攻击策略。对做训练的人来说，这些比单个 benchmark 分数更有信息量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 和 Vision 部分，抓住论文真正提出的对象：不是一个评测器，而是一条自动生成 adversarial training data 的训练管线。然后重点看 Section 3.2 的 threat model 和环境定义，理解 attacker 到底能改什么、不能改什么；这一部分决定了训练信号是否真实。接着看 Section 4 的 agentic harness，关注为什么要给 attacker 状态和工具，以及它如何利用交互式搜索。Section 5 是核心，重点看 self-play 如何扩展到 defender population、奖励如何定义、训练规模如何组织。Section 6 值得细读，因为它解释了怎样把普通 capability tasks 改造成 adversarial environments，这对很多安全训练工作都有可复用价值。实验部分优先看 Figure 1、Figure 2、Figure 9 以及关于 IPI Challenge、历史 GPT-5 系列攻防、GPT-5.6 鲁棒性提升的章节。精读时可以带着三个问题：一，攻击成功的 credit assignment 是怎么做的，怎样避免把无效噪声当成有效攻击；二，population training 如何平衡 attacker 泛化与训练稳定性；三，这种 flywheel 会不会出现 reward hacking，例如 attacker 学会利用环境 bug 而不是模型弱点。真正值得深挖的地方不是“它又找到了哪些花式攻击”，而是“怎样把开放式安全失败转成可规模化 RL 信号”。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI。文中明确以 OpenAI 生产模型与 RL post-training 基础设施为背景，围绕 GPT-5.2 至 GPT-5.6 的内部攻防训练展开；公开节选未给出完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a data-generation problem for robustness training, not merely an evaluation problem. Static red-teaming datasets are small, quickly exhausted, and easy for defenders to overfit to. What is missing is a scalable attacker that can adapt to a target model, iterate through interaction, and keep discovering fresh prompt-injection failures as the defender improves. GPT-Red is proposed as that attacker: an automated red-teaming agent trained through self-play so that adversarial examples become a renewable training signal rather than a fixed corpus.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is broader than safety benchmarking. First, it turns adversarial data generation into a trainable component, analogous to improving pretraining data pipelines except the product here is high-value post-training data. Second, it demonstrates a concrete attacker-defender flywheel: stronger attackers surface harder failures, stronger defenders force attackers to search for new strategies, and the training distribution keeps moving. That is directly relevant to the pretrain/post-train interface because it shows how post-training can benefit from continuously refreshed data rather than static human-written sets. Third, the paper makes an unusually explicit scaling claim: the attacker was trained with compute on the scale of major RL post-training runs and was integrated into successive production models from GPT-5.2 onward. That signals a shift from ad hoc safety evaluation to a dedicated large-scale training pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three main ingredients. The first is an agentic red-teaming harness. Instead of asking the attacker for a single-shot jailbreak prompt, the system gives it a stateful defender_model tool so it can probe, observe, revise, and retry. This matters because realistic prompt injection often depends on multi-turn interaction, tool outputs, file edits, and context-specific weaknesses that a one-pass generator will miss. The second ingredient is environment construction. Existing capability tasks are converted into adversarial RL environments under a realistic threat model: during the defender’s rollout, the attacker may be allowed to edit a designated tool response, a local file region, or another controlled insertion point. This keeps the attack surface close to real agent deployments while making the environment family extensible as production tasks expand. The third ingredient is large-scale self-play RL. The base game rewards the attacker for inducing valid failures and rewards the defender for resisting the attack while still completing its original task. Crucially, training is not limited to a single attacker-defender pair. The attacker is trained against a diverse, simultaneously trained population of strong defenders. That design is meant to prevent overfitting to one defender’s quirks and instead teach the attacker to identify model-specific weaknesses. The paper also frames scaling along three axes: inference-time compute through iterative search in the harness, environment diversity through many red-teaming scenarios and goals, and training compute through a very large RL run. The resulting GPT-Red is therefore a search-based adaptive attacker, not a prompt-template library.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical message is that GPT-Red finds more working attacks, transfers better, and keeps improving with additional test-time compute. The paper reports that it can reliably break prior GPT-5-series models up to GPT-5.5, outperform human red-teamers and a GPT-5.5 baseline on the 2025 IPI Challenge style setting, and transfer to real systems such as an AI-powered vending machine. Another important result is longitudinal rather than benchmark-specific: progressively stronger internal red-team models were used over roughly six months in the training of each production model since GPT-5.2, culminating in GPT-5.6 achieving the strongest robustness profile in their internal evaluation suites. The public text does not fully disclose all run details such as parameter counts, RL steps, or complete absolute metrics, but several experimental signals are especially informative. Test-time scaling is strong, which suggests the attacker is using search and adaptation rather than memorized attack strings. Training against a defender population improves generalization, indicating that the attacker is learning broader attack principles rather than exploiting one model’s idiosyncrasies. Out-of-distribution transfer across goals, harnesses, and target models further supports that interpretation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the vision section to anchor the paper correctly: the core contribution is a scalable adversarial-data engine for robustness training. Then read the threat-model and environment sections carefully, especially the part describing what the attacker is allowed to modify and when. Those choices determine whether the RL signal reflects realistic failures or synthetic artifacts. The agentic harness section is worth close attention because it explains why state, tools, and iterative interaction are necessary for red-teaming. The self-play training section is the center of the paper; focus on how the defender population is constructed, how rewards are assigned, and how the training setup avoids simple overfitting. The environment-conversion section is also useful because it shows how ordinary capability tasks can be turned into adversarial training environments. In the experiments, prioritize the figures and sections on IPI-style transfer, attacks on earlier GPT-5-series models, test-time scaling, and the robustness gains for GPT-5.6. Three questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: how valid failures are defined and credited, how population training trades off generalization against stability, and whether the setup is robust to reward hacking where the attacker exploits environment bugs rather than genuine model weaknesses.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI. The work is presented in the context of OpenAI’s production RL post-training stack and the GPT-5.2 to GPT-5.6 robustness pipeline; the full author list is not visible in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对 post-train 预算分配的 prior：安全不再是小规模 eval 附件，而是可吃下主力 RL 算力的常驻训练环节，建议立刻复现其 self-play population 设定。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on post-training budgets: safety is no longer a small eval add-on but a standing training loop that can consume major RL-scale compute; replicate the self-play population setup internally.

paper.title: Gubernaut: A Deterministic Homeostatic Controller for Affect-Regulated LLM Agents, Validated Across Independent Model Families
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents inherit reactive failure modes: escalation under provocation, sycophantic drift under flattery, perseveration when stuck. These are failures of propensity, not capability; they concern what a model does under sustained pressure, which training-time alignment reduces but does not eliminate at runtime. This research led to the Gubernaut Cognitive Controller (GCC), a model-agnostic runtime control layer in a Nelson--Narens monitoring--control loop: an object level

summary.core_problem: 尝试用一个运行时控制层抑制 LLM agent 在挑衅、奉承或反复失败时出现的升级、迎合和固着行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent runtime safety 方法。它把问题定义为 propensity failure：模型有能力给出合理回应，但在持续压力下选择了不稳的行为。对预训练研究的价值主要在于观察 alignment 训练无法完全消除的运行时失效模式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gubernaut Cognitive Controller，采用 Nelson–Narens monitoring-control loop。文本生成层负责读写文本；确定性的 meta level 只读取数值 telemetry，包括 intensity、valence、repetition，并返回调节姿态。由于 meta level 不读 token，作者称其在结构上没有 prompt injection 通道，但也说明尚未做对抗测试。
summary.experiments: 采用预注册的 generate-once/judge-many 协议，在四个 frontier model family 构成的 4x4 矩阵上评估；摘要未给出具体模型名称、样本量、judge 细节和量化提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a runtime controller to reduce LLM-agent escalation, sycophancy, and perseveration under provocation, flattery, or repeated failure.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent runtime-safety method. It frames the issue as a propensity failure: the model may have the capability to respond well but chooses unstable behavior under sustained pressure. For pretraining researchers, the main value is the failure-mode framing rather than the controller itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Gubernaut Cognitive Controller uses a Nelson–Narens monitoring-control loop. The object level reads and writes text, while a deterministic meta level reads only numeric telemetry—intensity, valence, and repetition—and emits a regulating posture. Because the meta level consumes no tokens, the authors argue that there is no prompt-injection channel to the controller by construction, though adversarial testing is not yet done.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a pre-registered generate-once/judge-many protocol across a 4x4 matrix of four frontier model families. The provided abstract does not specify model names, sample counts, judge details, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 思路比证据强；可看作 runtime alignment 失败分类，不宜把控制器效果当硬结论。
recommendation.en: The framing is stronger than the evidence; treat it as a runtime-alignment failure taxonomy, not as a hard result about the controller.

paper.title: Agent Security Needs Redefinition through a Holistic Framework
paper.abstract: Agent security is widely treated as a question about action content. Defenses ask whether an instruction looks malicious. Benchmarks ask whether an agent performs a harmful sounding action. \textbf{We argue that agent security is fundamentally a contextual problem, and that the current content based framing systematically misdefines it.} A command to ``delete user data'' might be a routine administrative request or a prompt injection attacking production systems, and the content alone cannot dis

summary.core_problem: 重新定义 agent security：安全性不能只看动作文本是否“恶意”，而必须结合授权来源、任务目标和执行轨迹上下文判断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全框架和评测范式批判。论文指出现有 prompt injection / agent safety 任务常把动作内容与授权上下文混在一起，导致 benchmark 可能测到的是内容分类能力，而不是真实的 agent 安全控制能力。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 contextual security 的四类联合属性，并要求在 agent 轨迹中持续评估。其中摘要明确提到 Source Authorization 用于判断指令来源，Task Alignment 用于判断动作是否服务于用户授权任务；其余属性因摘要截断无法完整确认。论文还用 AgentDojo 和 WASP 中的 injection 任务说明，同一动作在合法工作流和攻击场景中可能具有相同表面内容。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出新模型训练、参数规模或数值提升；主要实验/分析是对 AgentDojo 和 WASP injection tasks 的任务结构复核，强调这些任务中的危险动作本身也可能是认证用户的正常请求。
summary.authors_note: Dawn Song 是 UC Berkeley 计算机安全与可信 AI 方向的知名研究者，长期研究系统安全、隐私与 AI security。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes agent security as a contextual property: whether an action is safe cannot be determined from the action text alone, but depends on authorization, task intent, and trajectory context.
summary_en.importance: This is a framework and critique for agent security evaluation. It argues that many prompt-injection and agent-safety tasks conflate action content with authorization context, so they may measure content classification rather than real security control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper operationalizes contextual security through jointly required properties evaluated continuously along the agent trajectory. The abstract explicitly names Source Authorization, which identifies who issued a command, and Task Alignment, which checks whether the action serves the authorized task. It also analyzes AgentDojo and WASP injection tasks to show that the same action can be legitimate or malicious depending on context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model training, parameter counts, or accuracy gains. The evidence is primarily structural analysis of injection tasks in AgentDojo and WASP, showing that actions labeled harmful can also be plausible authenticated-user requests in routine workflows.
summary_en.authors_note: Dawn Song is a well-known UC Berkeley researcher in computer security, privacy, and trustworthy AI.

recommendation.zh: 读定义和 AgentDojo/WASP 批判即可；对预训练无直接动作，但会影响 tool-use 后训练数据怎么标安全。
recommendation.en: Read the definitions and the AgentDojo/WASP critique; it does not change pretraining, but it affects how tool-use post-training data should label safety.

paper.title: ChannelGuard: Safe Models Do Not Compose into Safe Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM applications chain a planner, worker agents, a verifier, and a synthesizer, and every hop between agents is an unmonitored channel through which an adversary can smuggle instructions. Existing defenses guard only the input boundary (IBProtector, Llama Guard, perplexity filters, SmoothLLM) or run outside the application as opaque, stochastic provider-side filters. We show this gap carries a consequence rarely measured: on a 2,100-trace evaluation across eight attack families, five

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：多智能体 LLM 系统里，单个模型看起来安全，并不意味着由 planner、worker、verifier、synthesizer 串起来的整体系统仍然安全，因为 agent 之间的中间通道会成为未监控的提示注入载体。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在评测与安全分析，而不是新模型方法。它指出现有安全报告常把“最终是否被拦住”当成唯一指标，却忽略真正起作用的是云厂商的服务端过滤还是 agent 自身对齐，从而把系统安全性归因搞错。这对做 agent 系统评测、尤其是 provider-dependent safety auditing，有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ChannelGuard，一个 training-free 的 defense-in-depth 框架，在多 agent 通道之间插入信息瓶颈式的监控与过滤组件，而不是只守输入边界。论文的关键技术点不是复杂建模，而是把攻击面从单轮输入扩展到 agent-to-agent channels，并显式区分输入侧防护、服务端黑盒过滤、以及模型自身 alignment 三种来源的拦截贡献。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 2100 条 trace、8 类攻击、5 种防御、3 个模型后端。文中最核心的结果是：某些在标准报告下看似 attack success 为 0 的 pipeline，其安全性主要来自 Azure GPT-5 的 provider-side filter，60 次阻断里有 54 次来自服务端；换到没有同类过滤的后端后，安全性归因会转移到模型自身 alignment，说明 outcome-only reporting 会掩盖真实脆弱点。摘要未给出更细的模型规模和完整对比表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a simple but under-measured issue: individually safe LLM components do not compose into a safe multi-agent system, because the inter-agent channels become unmonitored carriers for instruction smuggling and prompt injection.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in evaluation and security attribution rather than core modeling. The paper argues that standard outcome-only safety reporting can misattribute where safety actually comes from—provider-side filters, boundary defenses, or the model’s own alignment—which matters for any serious audit of agent pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChannelGuard is a training-free defense-in-depth framework that inserts monitoring and information-bottleneck style controls between agents, instead of guarding only the external input boundary. The main contribution is the shift in threat model: from single-turn input filtering to channel-level protection and attribution of blocking behavior across different safety layers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans 2,100 traces, 8 attack families, 5 defenses, and 3 model backends. The headline result is that a pipeline appearing perfectly safe under standard reporting can owe most of that safety to a cloud provider’s hidden server-side filter: 54 of 60 blocks on Azure GPT-5 came from the provider layer. The abstract does not expose full model sizes or all baselines.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但它提醒了一件常被忽略的事：agent 安全评测若不做归因分解，很多“安全结论”其实只是 provider filter 在兜底；看实验设计即可，不必细读方法。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully shows that many agent safety claims collapse once you separate model alignment from hidden provider-side filtering; read the attribution setup, not the full method.

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant information while rejecting deceptive or harmful content is therefore critical for reliable deployment in real-world retrieval settings. We introduce SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training

summary.core_problem: 研究RAG场景中模型如何在混合了有用证据、误导信息和指令注入的检索结果里选择性采纳证据。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是SelectBench评测与训练集，以及一个小规模RL后训练实验。它对RAG安全和后训练信号设计有参考意义，但数据规模和提升幅度都偏小。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造SelectBench，用受控样本测试模型是否采纳相关证据并拒绝欺骗或有害内容；随后用DAPO对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练，奖励来自确定性规则或冻结的语义judge。
summary.experiments: 在修正后的325例SelectBench-v2测试集上，原始checkpoint严格成功率为22.46%，DAPO-Rule达到25.54%，DAPO-DeepSeek达到26.46%。训练后模型减少了禁用内容采纳，回答更短更聚焦，但prompt-injection following没有改善。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自East China Normal University和Shandong University；未看到知名大模型实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether RAG-augmented LLMs can selectively use relevant evidence while rejecting misleading statements and instruction-like contamination.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is SelectBench plus a small RL post-training study. The result is relevant to RAG robustness and reward design, but the reported gains are modest and the test set is small.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build SelectBench as a controlled benchmark and training set, then post-train Qwen3.5-4B with DAPO using either deterministic rule rewards or a frozen semantic judge.
summary_en.experiments: On the corrected 325-example SelectBench-v2 test set, strict success improves from 22.46% for the base checkpoint to 25.54% with DAPO-Rule and 26.46% with DAPO-DeepSeek. The trained policies adopt less forbidden content and produce shorter answers, but prompt-injection following does not improve.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are East China Normal University and Shandong University.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表就够了：RL能压一点污染采纳，但没修好prompt injection，说明reward覆盖面太窄。
recommendation.en: The result table is enough: RL reduces some contaminated adoption, but prompt injection remains, pointing to a narrow reward signal.

paper.title: OpenEvoShield: Dual Non-Stationary Continual Defense for Open-World Multi-Agent System Attacks
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, where adversaries inject malicious instructions through inter-agent communication to propagate harmful behaviors. Unlike static threats, these attacks are doubly dynamic: adversaries refine injection strategies against deployed defenses while normal-agent behavior drifts with system expansion. Existing defenses treat deployment as a closed-world problem and degrade rapidly once either distribution

summary.core_problem: 解决开放世界 LLM 多智能体系统中，恶意指令会沿智能体通信链传播且攻防分布持续漂移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 安全防御方法。它关注部署后攻击策略和正常行为同时非平稳的场景，比静态 prompt-injection 防御更贴近长期运行的多智能体系统，但与基座预训练关系较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OpenEvoShield，一个协同演化的持续防御框架。方法包含四个模块：用非对称速率控制器区分快速攻击侧漂移和慢速正常侧漂移；用正常边界更新器维护动态行为边界；用带 EWC 正则的策略集成快速适应并减少遗忘；用能量模型融合节点、子图和图级多粒度信号做检测。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验设置和数值结果。可以确认其评估目标是开放世界 LLM-MAS 攻击下的持续防御能力，包括攻击策略变化和正常智能体行为漂移后的鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses open-world attacks in LLM-based multi-agent systems, where malicious instructions propagate through inter-agent communication and both attackers and benign agents drift over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent-safety method. Its useful angle is the non-stationary deployment setting, which is more realistic than closed-world prompt-injection defenses, but it has limited direct value for foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenEvoShield is a co-evolutionary continual defense framework. It uses an asymmetric rate controller to separate fast attacker drift from slower benign-behavior drift, a normal-boundary updater, an EWC-regularized policy ensemble to adapt without severe forgetting, and an energy-based detector over node-, subgraph-, and graph-level signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full experimental details or quantitative results. The evaluation appears to target continual robustness under evolving LLM-MAS attacks and drifting benign-agent behavior.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 安全漂移问题的备查即可；方法堆叠偏重，缺少可迁移到 pretrain 的训练信号洞察。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for agent-safety drift, but the method is component-heavy and offers little signal for pretraining research.

paper.title: Know Your Agent: Reconnaissance-Driven Pentesting of AI Agents
paper.abstract: Traditional pentesting uses reconnaissance at each step to uncover unseen weaknesses, build stronger attacks, and advance the objective; we argue that AI agents require the same treatment. We formalize agent reconnaissance by modeling the process and identifying the knowledge assets it seeks to extract: what they are, how they are used, and which agent weaknesses they exploit to give adversaries leverage in indirect prompt injection attacks. We instantiate these insights in Know Your Agent (KYA)

summary.core_problem: 研究黑盒 AI agent 在间接提示注入攻击下如何被系统性侦察，并把侦察信息转化为更强攻击。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 安全测试方法与可复现实验框架。它把传统渗透测试中的 reconnaissance 明确迁移到 AI agent 场景，关注攻击者如何提取工具、策略、约束和隐藏行为等知识资产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Know Your Agent（KYA）框架：先通过黑盒 probing 建立目标画像，再利用画像自动构造更有针对性的间接提示注入攻击。方法重点不是单次 jailbreak，而是把侦察、画像构建、攻击生成连成闭环。
summary.experiments: 在 agent-security benchmarks 和一个真实 coding agent 上评估 KYA，并发布框架、benchmark 与 baseline。摘要未给出具体攻击成功率、提升幅度或模型规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how black-box AI agents can be systematically reconnoitered and then attacked more effectively via indirect prompt injection.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an agent security testing methodology and reproducible framework. It imports the reconnaissance phase of conventional pentesting into AI-agent settings, focusing on knowledge assets such as tools, policies, constraints, and hidden behaviors.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Know Your Agent (KYA): the framework probes a target agent, builds a target profile, and uses that profile to craft stronger indirect prompt-injection attacks. The key move is a closed loop of reconnaissance, profiling, and attack generation rather than a one-shot jailbreak.
summary_en.experiments: KYA is evaluated on agent-security benchmarks and a real-world coding agent, with the framework, benchmarks, and baselines released. The abstract does not report concrete success rates, gains, or model sizes.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不直接，但 agent 暴露面建模值得留档；只看 threat model 和 KYA 流程即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the agent exposure model is worth filing; read only the threat model and KYA loop.

paper.title: Data Leakage Prevention in Agentic Applications via Preemptive Hardening
paper.abstract: Agentic systems integrate LLM driven planning with interfaces to external tools, making data leakage and tool misuse feasible via instruction/data boundary failures and prompt injection attacks. Enforcing required controls consistently is particularly challenging in workflows spanning many codebases and heterogeneous agents. To address this challenge in multi agentic systems, we present a pre-deployment pipeline for scanning, hardening, and validation of agentic applications. The pipeline analyz

summary.core_problem: 多Agent系统中prompt模板、工具接口与调用代码分布在异构代码库，难以系统性识别并修复数据泄露与工具滥用风险。
summary.importance: 工程与系统创新，提出部署前扫描、加固与验证一体化流水线，降低Agent应用的数据泄露面。
summary.technical_approach: 静态分析prompt模板、工具接口与调用代码识别泄露模式，按风险优先级施加最小侵入修复：schema收紧、边界清洗、白名单工具门控等，再用对抗prompt注入与良性输入变异做回归验证。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体测试集、基线与量化修复成功率，仅描述流水线各阶段设计。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent systems, prompt templates, tool interfaces, and invocation code are scattered across heterogeneous codebases, making systematic detection and mitigation of data leakage and tool misuse difficult.
summary_en.importance: Engineering and systems contribution; a pre-deployment pipeline that unifies scanning, hardening, and validation for agentic applications.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses static analysis on prompt templates, tool interfaces, and invocation code to identify leakage patterns; applies minimally invasive fixes prioritized by risk—schema tightening, boundary sanitization, allowlist-based tool gating—then validates via adversarial prompt injection and benign input variation.
summary_en.experiments: Test sets, baselines, and quantitative fix success rates are not disclosed in the abstract; only pipeline stages are described.

recommendation.zh: Agent应用部署侧的安全加固流水线，与预训练数据/架构/训练动态无关，了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: A deployment-side security hardening pipeline for agent apps, unrelated to pretraining data/architecture/dynamics; grasp the idea at a high level.

paper.title: Adaptive Adversaries: A Multi-Turn, Multi-LLM Benchmark for LLM Agent Security
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents process external content, exposing them to prompt injection and multi-turn manipulation. Most safety benchmarks evaluate defenders against fixed attack pools collected before evaluation, single-turn or multi-turn. We present a 21-scenario benchmark for \emph{adaptive multi-round attacks against memoryless LLM defenders}: an autonomous LLM attacker observes prior defender responses and pivots across rounds, while each defender response is evaluated as a fresh interaction. Holding

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM Agent 在面对自适应、多轮提示注入攻击时的安全性，而不是只测固定攻击池。
summary.importance: 这是 Agent security benchmark 贡献。它把攻击者建模为可观察防守方历史响应并逐轮调整策略的 LLM，从评测协议上挑战了静态攻击集的安全结论。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 21 个攻击场景；攻击端由自治 LLM 扮演，可根据上一轮防守响应改变攻击；防守端每次响应按 memoryless fresh interaction 处理；使用固定场景、固定攻击者/防守者和结构化输出评分，比较单轮与最多 15 轮自适应攻击。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告：只看第一轮攻击时 ASR 为 0–1%；允许 15 轮自适应攻击后 ASR 升至 5.4–14.0%。合并三个前沿攻击 LLM 能发现比最佳单一攻击者多 1.4–2.2 倍的 unique successful attacks，且与已有 benchmark 攻击的余弦相似度仅 0.02–0.14。摘要提到 Claude Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.4 在防守表现上接近。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM-agent security under adaptive, multi-turn prompt-injection attacks rather than fixed attack pools.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-security benchmark contribution. It changes the evaluation protocol by modeling the attacker as an LLM that observes prior defender responses and adapts across rounds, challenging conclusions drawn from static attack sets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 21 scenarios. An autonomous LLM attacker observes previous defender outputs and pivots over rounds, while each defender response is scored as a memoryless fresh interaction. Scenarios, attackers, defenders, and structured-output scoring are held fixed, and first-turn scoring is compared against up to 15 rounds of adaptive attack.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 0–1% ASR when scoring only the first attacker turn, rising to 5.4–14.0% with 15 adaptive rounds. Pooling three frontier attacker LLMs finds 1.4–2.2x more unique successful attacks than the best single attacker, with low cosine similarity to existing benchmark attacks, 0.02–0.14. The abstract states that Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 are close as defenders.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议和 ASR 对比即可；它修正了“固定攻击池足够测安全”的弱 prior，但不是训练方法。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and ASR tables; it weakens the fixed-attack-pool prior, but it is an evaluation paper rather than a training recipe.

paper.title: PlanFlip: Attacking Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Planning-Phase Prompt Injection
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on a Planner to decompose goals into sub-task sequences that downstream Executor and Critic agents execute and audit. We identify the planning phase as a critical attack surface: a single injection into the Planner's context achieves cascade amplification, corrupting all downstream sub-tasks simultaneously. We introduce PlanFlip, a framework comprising four planning-phase prompt injection attacks -- GoalSubstitution (PF-1), PriorityInversion (PF-2), Cont

summary.core_problem: 多Agent LLM系统的规划阶段存在未被覆盖的提示注入攻击面，现有基于关键词过滤的防护无法抵御该环节的伪装攻击
summary.importance: 方法创新（提出4种规划阶段提示注入攻击）+ 反常识发现，首次系统研究多Agent规划层的注入攻击漏洞
summary.technical_approach: 提出PlanFlip框架，设计4种伪装为合法工具输出的攻击：目标替换（PF-1）、优先级反转（PF-2）、上下文污染（PF-3）、角色混淆（PF-4），绕过关键词过滤机制
summary.experiments: 在9个前沿LLM上开展3479个episode测试，发现：1）GPT-5攻击成功率最高（ASR=0.68），模型能力越强 vulnerability 越高；2）同构Agent pipeline（GPT-4o+Llama-3.3-70B）ASR接近0但隐蔽性得分为1

summary_en.core_problem: The planning phase of multi-agent LLM systems is an unaddressed prompt injection attack surface, and existing keyword-filter-based defenses cannot resist disguised attacks targeting this phase
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation (4 planning-phase prompt injection attacks) + counterintuitive findings; first systematic study of injection vulnerabilities in multi-agent planning layers
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the PlanFlip framework with 4 attacks disguised as legitimate tool outputs: GoalSubstitution (PF-1), PriorityInversion (PF-2), ContextPollution (PF-3), RoleConfusion (PF-4), designed to evade keyword filters
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 9 frontier LLMs across 3,479 episodes; findings: 1) GPT-5 achieves the highest attack success rate (ASR=0.68), with model capability positively correlating with vulnerability; 2) Homogeneous agent pipelines (GPT-4o + Llama-3.3-70B) show near-zero ASR but a perfect stealth score of 1

recommendation.zh: 多Agent规划层攻击的反常识结论可做安全对齐的弱信号，仅看实验部分的两个核心发现即可
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive findings on multi-agent planning-layer attacks serve as weak signal for safety alignment; only read the two core experimental conclusions.

paper.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
paper.abstract: Explore GPT-Red, OpenAI’s automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness.

summary.core_problem: 提出 GPT-Red，用自动化红队和自博弈机制提升模型在安全、对齐和 prompt injection 场景下的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 价值在于把红队从人工发现问题扩展到模型驱动的持续攻击与改进循环；这对后训练数据生成、安全评测闭环和对抗式训练信号设计有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 从摘要看，GPT-Red 使用 self-play 方式生成或发现攻击样例，让模型在攻击者与防御者角色之间迭代，从而自动挖掘脆弱提示、prompt injection 路径和安全失效模式。方法更接近自动化红队系统与对抗数据生成，而不是新的基座预训练目标。
summary.experiments: 公开摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline、量化提升或完整评测表；需要看正文是否披露攻击成功率、鲁棒性提升、人工红队对比和迁移性结果。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 发布；文章关注自动化红队、自博弈安全改进和 prompt injection robustness。

summary_en.core_problem: GPT-Red aims to improve model robustness for safety, alignment, and prompt-injection settings through automated red teaming and self-play.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is the shift from human-only red teaming toward a model-driven loop that continuously generates attacks and hardens defenses, which is relevant to post-training data generation, safety evaluation loops, and adversarial training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the abstract, GPT-Red uses self-play to let models explore attacker and defender roles, surfacing adversarial prompts, prompt-injection paths, and safety failures. It is best read as an automated red-teaming and adversarial-data system, not as a new base-model pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments: The provided summary does not report model sizes, training data, baselines, quantitative gains, or full evaluation tables; the useful details would be attack success rates, robustness deltas, human-red-team comparisons, and transfer behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by OpenAI Research, focused on automated red teaming, self-play safety improvement, and prompt-injection robustness.

recommendation.zh: 读方法闭环和失败案例就够；若指标透明，它能指导内部安全数据生成，但别把博客结论当训练定律。
recommendation.en: Read the loop design and failure cases; if metrics are transparent, it can guide internal safety data generation, but do not treat the blog claim as a training law.

paper.title: Isolation as a First-Class Principle for LLM-Agent System Safety: Concepts, Taxonomy, Challenges and Future Directions
paper.abstract: The capability of LLM agents to function as the ``brain'' of a system fundamentally expands the scope of analysis beyond a standalone model. Consequently, safety is no longer only about input--output content alignment. It also concerns system behavior and real-world execution outcomes. However, the current literature is fragmented across attack types, applications, and benchmarks. This makes it hard to explain why failures such as prompt injection, tool misuse, and memory poisoning often share t

summary.core_problem: 如何用“隔离（isolation）”这一系统原则，统一解释并缓解 LLM-agent 工作流中的安全失败（提示注入、工具滥用、记忆投毒等）。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念框架/分类学：把碎片化的 agent 安全文献按“边界”组织，帮助工程团队在设计与审计时有一套可复用的威胁建模坐标系，而不是按攻击名词堆列表。
summary.technical_approach: 提出以边界为中心的 taxonomy：user-agent、agent-tool、agent-execution、agent-agent、system-environment 五类边界；把攻击与失效模式映射到边界穿透/污染传播路径，并讨论隔离实现的挑战（上下文分区、权限最小化、通道分离、跨代理通信约束、环境输入的信任分级等）。
summary.experiments: 综述/概念论文，未见可复现的系统实验或统一基准上的定量对比（从摘要信息判断）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to use “isolation” as a unifying system principle to explain and mitigate safety failures in LLM-agent workflows (prompt injection, tool misuse, memory poisoning, etc.).
summary_en.importance: A conceptual/taxonomy contribution: reorganizes fragmented agent-safety literature around boundaries, giving practitioners a reusable threat-modeling lens rather than a list of attack names.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a boundary-centric taxonomy with five boundaries (user–agent, agent–tool, agent–execution, agent–agent, system–environment), mapping failures to boundary breaches and contamination propagation; discusses implementation challenges such as context partitioning, least privilege, channel separation, constrained inter-agent comms, and trust-tiering environment context.
summary_en.experiments: Survey/concept paper; no clear reproducible system experiments or quantitative benchmark results based on the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 当作安全威胁建模的“术语表+检查清单”即可；对预训练没直接增益，读 taxonomy 那几段就够。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a threat-modeling glossary/checklist; little direct pretraining value—skim the boundary taxonomy sections only.

paper.title: Prismata: Confining Cross-Site Prompt Injection in Web Agents
paper.abstract: Autonomous web agents promise to automate everyday browsing tasks, but inherit one of the web's oldest attack surfaces. Cross-Site Scripting proved that mixing trusted and untrusted content is dangerous, even on benign pages. Agents resurface this risk by interpreting natural language as instructions, allowing third-party and user-generated content to hijack the agent via prompt injection. The core challenge is that deriving a task-specific security policy requires reasoning over page structure

summary.core_problem: 自主Web Agent存在跨站提示注入风险，第三方内容可劫持Agent，而现有方法难以区分页面中可信与不可信内容的权限边界。
summary.importance: 提出针对Web Agent的上下文最小权限防御框架Prismata，结合经典完整性模型实现结构与机械双重约束，属于Agent安全领域的方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 通过动态信任推导为页面内容生成权限标签（错误仅降权的结构约束保证），并通过机械约束执行权限，限制Agent的可见内容与可执行操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验设置与效果数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Autonomous web agents face cross-site prompt injection risks where third-party content can hijack the agent, and existing methods struggle to distinguish permission boundaries between trusted and untrusted page content.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Prismata, a contextual least-privilege defense framework for web agents, combining structural and mechanical constraints inspired by classical integrity models, contributing to agent security methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generates permission labels for page content via dynamic trust derivation (with structural guarantee that labeling errors only reduce privilege), and enforces permissions via mechanical confinement to limit agent visibility and actions.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup and performance data are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: Web Agent安全的系统级防御方案，与基座预训练关联弱，仅需了解权限约束思路即可。
recommendation.en: System-level defense for web agent security, weak relevance to base pretraining; only the privilege constraint idea is worth noting.

paper.title: Seduced by the Narrative: Assessing Rule Adherence in Semi-Open Textual Sandboxes
paper.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous adjudicators in semi-open textual game environments, robust rule adherence becomes critical when user intent conflicts with system rules. However, these models are trained to be helpful and compliant, leaving them vulnerable to a class of attacks we term \textit{Rhetorical Injection}, where adversarial users exploit narrative framing techniques such as pseudo-logical reasoning and authoritative coercion to bypass adjudication logic. We present CoC-

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在半开放文本沙盒中担任规则裁决者时，面对带有叙事操纵和伪逻辑包装的用户输入，是否会违背显式规则。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是一个针对 rule adherence 的对抗式 benchmark，而不是提出新模型。它把“助人性/顺从性”与“规则执行”之间的张力具体化到自然语言沙盒环境，对 agent judge、tool-use guardrail 和模型行为评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoC-Seduce，多智能体生成对抗样本，基于 TRPG 机制构造半开放文本环境。攻击重点不是 prompt injection 的系统提示泄露，而是 rhetorical injection：通过伪逻辑推演、权威施压、叙事诱导等方式，让模型在表面合理的故事框架下放松规则裁决。随后用 20 个目标 adjudicator 在 4 个世界设定、16 个技能类别上做系统评测。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 5,376 个样本，对抗样本由 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash 生成。实验对象覆盖 20 个裁决模型。摘要可见其评测维度围绕规则遵守率与攻击成功率展开，但未给出更细的模型规模、统计显著性或与传统 prompt injection 基线的完整对照；从定位看更像行为安全评测资产，而非训练方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Alberta、Qilu University of Technology。未见一线大模型实验室背景；更像学术侧的行为评测工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs acting as adjudicators in semi-open textual sandboxes can still follow explicit rules when users use narrative manipulation and pseudo-reasoning to pressure the model into violating them.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an adversarial benchmark for rule adherence rather than a new model. It operationalizes the tension between helpfulness/compliance and strict rule execution in natural-language sandbox settings, which is relevant to agent judges, tool-use guardrails, and behavioral evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces CoC-Seduce, a multi-agent adversarial benchmark built on TRPG-style mechanics. The attack is not classic system-prompt leakage, but rhetorical injection: pseudo-logical arguments, authority framing, and narrative coercion that make rule breaking appear justified inside the story. The benchmark then evaluates 20 target adjudicators across 4 world settings and 16 skill categories.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 5,376 samples, with adversarial cases generated by GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3.5 Flash. Twenty target adjudicator models are tested. From the abstract, the evaluation focuses on rule adherence and attack success, but it does not expose enough detail on model scales, significance, or clean baselines against standard prompt-injection setups; this reads more like a behavioral evaluation asset than a training-method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Alberta and Qilu University of Technology. This appears to be an academic behavioral-evaluation effort rather than a frontier-lab methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent judge 或行为对齐的人可以看，但对 pretrain 只算边缘信号；先看 benchmark 设计和攻击 taxonomy，别把它误读成训练结论。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about agent judges or behavioral alignment, but only peripheral for pretraining; read the benchmark design and attack taxonomy, not as a training conclusion.

paper.title: On the Inseparability of Instructions and Data in Shared-Embedding Sequence Models
paper.abstract: Prompt injection is the top security risk for LLM-integrated applications, yet every defense proposed so far has been broken. We prove this is not a coincidence: in shared-embedding architectures that lack enforced control-data separation, perfect prompt-injection prevention is mathematically impossible. We formalize prompted systems as Prompted Action Models whose outputs include control-authoritative actions: refusal decisions, tool authorization, policy routing, and memory writes. We define S

summary.core_problem: 形式化证明共享嵌入的序列模型（当前主流LLM架构）是否存在完美的prompt注入防御方案。
summary.importance: 范式级基础理论突破，首次通过严格数学证明指出现有LLM架构下指令与数据不可分离，完美prompt注入防御不可能实现，直接修正了领域安全研究的默认预期。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化定义提示驱动系统为Prompted Action Models（PAM），提出语义忠实控制（SFC）作为安全属性标准，通过三个独立证明（溯源恢复不可能性、控制路径暴露、计算不可区分性）推导SFC在共享嵌入架构下不可达，并给出统计不可分离性的定量下界。
summary.experiments: 全部为形式化数学证明，无实证实验；给出共享嵌入下可信与不可信内容的总变分距离下界为Ω(1/√d)（d为嵌入维度），定量刻画了不可分离性的架构边界。

summary_en.core_problem: Formally prove whether perfect prompt injection defense is achievable in shared-embedding sequence models (current mainstream LLM architectures).
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level fundamental theoretical breakthrough, first strict mathematical proof that instructions and data are inseparable in current LLMs, making perfect prompt injection defense impossible, directly revising default assumptions in LLM security research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes prompted systems as Prompted Action Models (PAMs), defines Semantic-Faithful Control (SFC) as the security property standard, and proves SFC is unachievable in shared-embedding architectures via three independent proofs (provenance recovery impossibility, control-path exposure, computational indistinguishability), with a quantitative lower bound for statistical inseparability.
summary_en.experiments: Entirely formal mathematical proofs, no empirical experiments; gives a Ω(1/√d) lower bound (d = embedding dimension) for total variation distance between trusted and untrusted content in shared embeddings, quantitatively characterizing the architectural boundary of inseparability.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变现有LLM共享嵌入架构的安全边界认知，做架构设计或对齐安全的研究员必须精读§3的三个不可能性证明。
recommendation.en: Directly redefines the security boundary of current shared-embedding LLMs; architecture and alignment security researchers must closely read Section 3’s three impossibility proofs.

paper.title: Adaptive Evaluation of Out-of-Band Defenses Against Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Recent work (2024 to 2026) has converged on a strategy for defending tool-using LLM agents against indirect prompt injection: rather than training the model to refuse malicious instructions, enforce security outside the model with a deterministic policy that mediates the agent's actions. Systems such as CaMeL, FIDES, Progent, RTBAS, and FORGE realize this with capabilities, information-flow labels, and reference monitors, and several report near-elimination of attacks on the AgentDojo benchmark.

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent的带外prompt注入防御仅在静态固定攻击集上验证，复用了之前带内防御评测中已被证明存在严重高估缺陷的方法，无法反映真实攻击下的防御能力
summary.importance: 评测方法创新+安全分析，首次将带外防御归类为经典完整性保护/引用监控/最小权限实例，提出自适应、防御感知的攻击方法验证现有防御的真实有效性
summary.technical_approach: 1）将CaMeL、FIDES等带外防御按经典安全框架（Biba完整性、引用监控、最小权限）结构化分类；2）设计自适应、防御感知的prompt注入攻击，替代静态固定攻击集进行防御有效性评测
summary.experiments: 对CaMeL、FIDES等6种主流带外防御开展自适应、防御感知攻击评测，验证静态评测下的防御成功率存在严重高估（具体数值摘要未完整披露）
summary.authors_note: LaunchSafe Research（网络安全/AI安全研究机构）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing out-of-band prompt injection defenses for LLM agents are only validated on static fixed attack sets, reusing the same flawed evaluation methodology that caused in-band defenses to appear effective before adaptive attacks broke them, failing to reflect real-world defense performance
summary_en.importance: Novel evaluation methodology and security analysis that first classifies out-of-band defenses as classical integrity protection/reference monitoring/least privilege instances, and proposes adaptive, defense-aware attacks to validate true defense effectiveness
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Structurally categorize out-of-band defenses (CaMeL, FIDES, etc.) under classic security frameworks (Biba integrity, reference monitoring, least privilege); 2) Design adaptive, defense-aware prompt injection attacks to replace static fixed attack sets for defense evaluation
summary_en.experiments: Conducted adaptive, defense-aware attack evaluations on 6 mainstream out-of-band defenses including CaMeL and FIDES, verifying that static evaluations severely overestimate defense success rates (specific metrics not fully disclosed in abstract)

recommendation.zh: 作为AI安全评测的弱信号参考，仅需看§2的带外防御结构化分类框架，无需复现实验
recommendation.en: Weak signal reference for AI security evaluation; only §2 structured out-of-band defense taxonomy needs review, no reproduction required

paper.title: MIRAGE: Stealthy Visual Prompt Injection for Vulnerability Detection in Web Agents
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based web agents provide practical, high-precision solutions for visual browser automation; however, they inherently expand the attack surface, introducing novel vision-based vulnerabilities. Existing adversarial evaluations targeting these agents frequently rely on permissive threat models and visually conspicuous artifacts. In this paper, we investigate a constrained vulnerability detection setting: a trusted web platform where the evaluator acts solely a

summary.core_problem: 在“可信网站 + 第三方仅能控制页面局部合法区域（如广告位）”的现实威胁模型下，如何对基于截图的 MLLM web agent 进行隐蔽的视觉间接提示注入，实现对下一步动作文本的定向劫持。
summary.importance: 与 LLM 基座预训练关系较弱，核心是安全评测/攻击方法，主要贡献在 web agent 的视觉攻击面与更严格的 threat model。对预训练研究的间接启发是：1）多模态统一建模把渲染像素纳入上下文后，prompt injection 的边界从“文本/DOM”扩展到“视觉 token/像素”；2）扩散先验用于约束对抗补丁的自然性，提示生成式先验可作为攻击与防御的共同工具。但它不提供预训练数据、训练动态或 scaling 方面的直接结论。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 MIRAGE：在攻击者可控 mask 内进行优化，联合两类信号。
- diffusion-guided patch：用扩散模型先验在局部区域合成“看起来合理”的内容，避免明显的对抗噪声；优化在虚拟 screenshot 空间中进行，最终与原图按 mask 合成。
- sparse residual perturbation：在少量视觉上不显眼（文中提到 dark-pixel）的像素上叠加稀疏残差，增强对目标 next-action 文本的控制力。
- curvature loss：为扩散采样/优化引入曲率相关损失以缓解局部最小值、扩大搜索。
- 以替代（surrogate）的视觉语言 web agent 为目标，使用定向 next-action objective 做梯度引导；由于不改 DOM，攻击聚焦在 action generation 阶段（而非 grounding）。
summary.experiments: 在 SeeAct 与 OpenClaw 上做系统评估，覆盖多个开源 MLLM web-agent 后端，并与现有 screenshot/text-based 攻击基线对比，结论是 MIRAGE 在严格空间约束与视觉自然性约束下仍能实现有效的 targeted next-action hijacking。给定内容片段未包含具体成功率/ASR 数字与可视化案例细节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（15–25 分钟）：
- 重点看 threat model 定义与约束条件：攻击者能控制什么、不能控制什么，这决定了方法是否贴近真实部署。
- 看方法部分的三块：mask 合成流程、扩散先验如何嵌入优化、稀疏残差与 curvature loss 的作用。
- 实验部分主要看：跨后端泛化、与基线的对比设置是否公平、是否有人类可感知性评估。
如果关注的是预训练，只需把它当作“多模态上下文带来的新攻击面”案例即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Under a realistic web-agent threat model where the platform is trusted and an attacker can only control a small, legitimate on-page visual region (e.g., an ad slot), how can one perform stealthy visual prompt injection to hijack an MLLM-based agent’s next-action generation toward a targeted instruction?
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a security/robustness paper rather than a pretraining one. Its indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining is that multimodal agents expand the prompt-injection boundary from text/DOM to rendered pixels, and that generative priors (diffusion) can be used to keep adversarial content natural-looking—an idea that matters for both attacks and defenses. It does not contribute directly to data mixture, scaling laws, optimization, or training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MIRAGE is a masked, diffusion-guided visual indirect prompt injection framework:
- Constrained editing: all modifications are restricted to an attacker-controlled mask and composited back into the screenshot.
- Diffusion prior: a diffusion model is used to synthesize locally plausible content within the mask, avoiding conspicuous adversarial artifacts.
- Sparse residuals: add sparse perturbations on visually inconspicuous pixels (notably dark pixels) to strengthen targeted control under tight spatial budget.
- Curvature loss: an additional loss term intended to escape poor local minima and broaden the search during diffusion sampling.
- Optimization is guided by a targeted next-action objective on a surrogate VLM web agent; since DOM is unchanged, the attack focuses on the action-generation stage rather than grounding.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on SeeAct and OpenClaw, across multiple open-source MLLM web-agent backends, and compared against prior screenshot-level and text-based attack baselines. The reported takeaway is that MIRAGE achieves effective targeted next-action hijacking while staying within strict spatial and plausibility constraints. The provided excerpt does not include concrete ASR numbers or detailed ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (15–25 minutes):
- Read the threat model carefully; it is the main novelty (bounded, legitimate region control).
- In the method, focus on how diffusion is integrated into the constrained optimization, and what the sparse residual + curvature loss add beyond a pure diffusion patch.
- In experiments, check cross-backend transfer and whether “stealthiness” is evaluated (human perceptibility, artifact metrics).
For pretraining-focused readers, treat it as an example of new multimodal attack surfaces rather than a training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 威胁模型收紧得比较干净：只控广告位还能劫持next-action，这对“视觉token进LM”的agent安全是硬问题；读清 threat model 与成功率表即可。
recommendation.en: A cleaner, more realistic threat model (ad-slot-only control) that still hijacks next actions—worth skimming for the threat model + success-rate tables; it’s a real safety issue for vision-token web agents.

paper.title: Analyzing the Narration Gap in LLM-Solver Loops
paper.abstract: Formal tools such as SAT and SMT solvers are increasingly embedded in language model reasoning pipelines when a safety or security critical question can be formulated in logic. Unlike chain of thought whose steps are sampled from the model distribution without formal guarantee, a solver produces a sound and independently verifiable answer. However, the soundness guarantee can be lost in the interaction between the solver and the model. The hybrid pipeline has three components: formalizing the qu

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 调用 SAT/SMT 等形式化 solver 后，如何在把 solver 输出转写成用户答案时丢失原本的 soundness guarantee。
summary.importance: 贡献是 tool-use / LLM-solver pipeline 的可靠性分析，指出形式化工具的正确性不会自动传递到最终自然语言回答；对通用 agent 工具调用安全有参考价值，但不直接服务于基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LLM-solver loop 建模为 verified decision procedure，拆分为 formalization、decision、narration 三段；重点研究 narration step，并用 certificate gating 约束 solver verdict，再测试 prompt injection 对最终叙述的影响。
summary.experiments: 评估 5 个开源模型在 prompt injection 下的表现；摘要称 certificate gating 可保持 solver verdict 的 soundness，但攻击者仍可通过不同措辞和 channel 反转最终自然语言结论。未给出具体模型名单和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLM pipelines that call SAT/SMT solvers can lose formal soundness when the solver’s output is narrated back to the user.
summary_en.importance: It is a reliability analysis for tool-using LLM systems. The main value is separating solver correctness from answer narration, showing that a formally verified decision can still be corrupted in the final language layer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors model the LLM-solver loop as a verified decision procedure with three stages: formalization, decision, and narration. They focus on the narration stage, apply certificate gating to protect solver verdicts, and test prompt-injection attacks against the final answer.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates five open-source models under prompt injection. The abstract reports that certificate gating preserves the solver verdict, while adversarial prompts can still invert the verified conclusion across phrasings and channels. Model names and exact numbers are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 工具调用安全的边界案例；只看 narration gap 的形式化和攻击样例，和预训练关系很远。
recommendation.en: A useful boundary case for tool-use safety; read the narration-gap formalization and attack examples, not as a pretraining paper.

paper.title: Analyzing Defensive Misdirection Against Model-Guided Automated Attacks on Agentic AI Systems
paper.abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on language-model components to interpret instructions, process external data, invoke tools, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make prompt-injection and jailbreak attacks more consequential, especially as attackers adopt model-guided automation to scale probing, prompt refinement, and response evaluation. This work analyzes the resulting attack-defense setting through a probabilistic model of a target system, its defense mechanism, and the

summary.core_problem: 分析当攻击者也使用模型自动搜索时，agentic AI 系统的 detect-and-block 防御为什么可能反而向攻击者提供有效反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 安全机制分析。它关注自动化攻击、攻击者 judge、拒答反馈和查询预算之间的关系，对 agent 安全评测和防御设计有参考价值，但不直接推进预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 构建目标系统、防御机制和攻击者自动 judge 的概率模型。先分析 detect-and-block：可预测拒答会让攻击搜索更容易区分有效方向；再分析 detect-and-misdirect：对检测到的恶意交互返回受控、不可操作响应，使攻击者 judge 产生 false-positive，从而降低其正预测值和搜索效率。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要呈现理论/概率分析，没有报告具体模型参数、数据集或实测 ASR 曲线。关键结论是随着查询预算增长，传统 detect-and-block 的 attacker success rate 可趋近 1；misdirection 可降低攻击者 judge 的 positive predictive value。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes why detect-and-block defenses for agentic AI systems may give useful feedback to model-guided automated attackers.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety mechanism analysis. It is useful for thinking about automated attack loops, attacker-side judges, refusal feedback, and query budgets, but it does not directly affect pretraining recipes or base-model objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate a probabilistic model of the target system, its defense, and the attacker's automated judge. They analyze detect-and-block, where predictable refusals help automated search, and detect-and-misdirect, where detected malicious interactions receive controlled non-operational responses intended to induce false positives in the attacker judge.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes analytical results rather than concrete model-scale experiments. The central claim is that, as query budget grows, attacker success rate under conventional detect-and-block can approach one, while misdirection reduces the positive predictive value of the attacker-side judge.

recommendation.zh: 把拒答当作攻击反馈的分析值得记；模型假设强，只看定理条件和失效情形。
recommendation.en: The refusal-as-feedback argument is worth remembering; assumptions are strong, so read the theorem conditions and failure cases.

paper.title: Evaluating Prompting-Based Defenses Against Domain-Camouflaged Injection Attacks
paper.abstract: Domain-camouflaged injection attacks embed malicious instructions in retrieved content using domain-appropriate vocabulary, evading standard detectors that rely on syntactic injection markers. When detection fails, practitioners need to know which defense architectures reduce attack success. We evaluate five prompting-based defenses (spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combinations) against domain-camouflaged injection across three model families (Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B,

summary.core_problem: 解决域伪装prompt注入攻击（恶意指令嵌入域相关词汇绕过句法检测器）缺乏系统防御效果评估的问题。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献+评测分析，构建了跨3模型家族、3部署域的3510条测试样本集，系统评估5种基于提示的防御方法的实际效果。
summary.technical_approach: 构造金融、法律、通用三类域的伪装注入攻击样本，评估spotlighting、paraphrasing、prompt sandwiching及两种组合防御的效果，同时对比Llama Guard 4配置的检测性能。
summary.experiments: 在Claude Haiku、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemini 2.0 Flash三个模型上开展3510次试验：paraphrasing是最稳定的防御方法，可将攻击成功率降低55-84%，且在所有模型上优于测试的Llama Guard 4配置；防御效果高度依赖模型，spotlighting仅在Claude Haiku上可降低一半攻击成功率，其余模型上无显著效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of prompting-based defenses against domain-camouflaged prompt injection attacks, which embed malicious instructions in domain-specific vocabulary to evade syntactic detectors.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution + evaluation analysis; builds a test set of 3,510 trials across 3 model families and 3 deployment domains, systematically evaluates 5 prompting-based defense methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs domain-camouflaged injection samples across financial, legal, and general domains, evaluates 5 defenses (spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combined variants), and compares performance against a configured Llama Guard 4 detector.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted 3,510 trials on Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemini 2.0 Flash: Paraphrasing is the most consistently effective defense, reducing attack success rate by 55-84% and outperforming the tested Llama Guard 4 setup on all models; Defense effectiveness is highly model-dependent, with spotlighting only halving attack success on Claude Haiku and showing no significant effect on other models.

recommendation.zh: 纯LLM安全评测工作，与基座预训练无直接关联，仅作为对齐防御方向的背景文献备查，无需阅读正文。
recommendation.en: Pure LLM security evaluation work with no direct relevance to foundation pretraining; only for reference as alignment defense background, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: PARSE: Provenance-Aware Retrieval Sanitization for Professional Domain LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Prompt injection defenses evaluated on synthetic benchmarks do not generalize to real enterprise documents, which are longer, denser, and interleave legitimate authority language with factual content. We demonstrate this gap with a real-document benchmark of 122 tasks across five professional domains (financial, legal, medical, scientific, DevOps) using actual SEC filings, Federal Register rules, PubMed abstracts, arXiv papers, and GitHub postmortems. Paraphrasing, the strongest defense on synth

summary.core_problem: 解决现有提示注入防御在真实企业长文档场景下泛化性差、效用损失大的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+评测资产贡献：首次构建覆盖5大专业领域的真实文档提示注入基准，提出兼顾事实保留与攻击过滤的检索清洗 pipeline
summary.technical_approach: 提出PARSE框架：1）句子级注入概率分类；2）重写前提取结构化事实；3）一致性校验环验证事实保留；4）指令门控路由无需清洗的文档，核心是基于来源感知的细粒度清洗而非全局改写
summary.experiments: 构建122个任务的真实文档基准（覆盖SEC文件、联邦法规、PubMed、arXiv、GitHub事后分析），验证paraphrasing在真实场景下攻击成功率无显著下降（p=0.5）且效用从91.8%降至82.8%；PARSE保留90%+效用的同时显著降低攻击成功率

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the poor generalization and high utility loss of existing prompt injection defenses on long real-world enterprise documents
summary_en.importance: Method innovation + benchmark contribution: builds the first real-document prompt injection benchmark covering 5 professional domains, proposes a retrieval sanitization pipeline balancing fact preservation and attack filtering
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PARSE framework: 1) sentence-level injection likelihood classification; 2) structured fact extraction before rewriting; 3) consistency-check loop for fact preservation; 4) directiveness gate to route clean documents; core is provenance-aware fine-grained sanitization instead of global paraphrasing
summary_en.experiments: Built a 122-task real-document benchmark covering SEC filings, Federal Register rules, PubMed, arXiv, GitHub postmortems; paraphrasing brings no significant attack rate reduction (p=0.5) and cuts utility from 91.8% to 82.8%; PARSE reduces attack rate significantly with 90%+ utility retained

recommendation.zh: 仅需记住核心结论：合成基准上最优的paraphrasing防御在真实企业文档中完全失效，具体方法无需深读
recommendation.en: Only remember the core conclusion: paraphrasing, the top defense on synthetic benchmarks, fails completely on real enterprise documents; no need to dive into method details

paper.title: Data Agents Under Attack: Vulnerabilities in LLM-Driven Analytical Systems
paper.abstract: Data agents integrate LLM-driven reasoning with relational data access, executable analytical tools, and multi-step workflow orchestration, making them increasingly central to enterprise analytics. This integration introduces new security vulnerabilities across data resources, database execution, and agent reasoning, recombining concerns from database security and general-purpose LLM-agent security into failure modes that neither line of work captures on its own. To address this gap, we present

summary.core_problem: LLM驱动的数据分析型agent（连数据库、跑SQL/工具、编排多步流程）出现新的安全失效模式，传统DB安全或通用LLM-agent安全都覆盖不全。
summary.importance: 偏系统安全与威胁建模：给出分层漏洞框架与攻击分类，并用“基于真实schema的payload生成”做系统化评估；对做tool-use/agent的研究员是直接可用的failure mode清单，也能反向约束训练信号与对齐目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三块：1) 分层漏洞框架（解释/执行/策略层）并总结8类风险；2) 按对手目标-战术-技术组织的攻击taxonomy（3目标、7战术、14技术）；3) 基于真实数据库schema的LLM驱动payload生成流水线，用于构造攻击与测试用例并评估数据agent。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体被测系统/模型、成功率、覆盖范围等量化结果；但明确在真实数据库schema上做攻击生成与评估（需看正文的attack success rate与防护对比）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-driven data agents (DB access + executable tools + multi-step workflows) introduce security failure modes not fully captured by classic DB security or generic LLM-agent security.
summary_en.importance: Systematic security/threat-modeling contribution: a layered vulnerability framework plus an attack taxonomy, and an evaluation pipeline that generates payloads grounded in real DB schemas. Useful as a concrete failure-mode checklist for tool-use agents and as constraints for alignment/training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three parts: (1) a layered vulnerability framework (interpretation/execution/policy) with eight risks; (2) an attack taxonomy by adversary goal/tactic/technique (3 goals, 7 tactics, 14 techniques); (3) an LLM-driven payload generation pipeline grounded in real database schemas to create attacks and evaluate data agents.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits specific systems/models and quantitative rates; it indicates evaluation with payloads grounded in real DB schemas—check the paper for attack success rates and mitigation comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 把“数据agent安全”拆成解释/执行/策略三层很实用；只看taxonomy表和schema-grounded payload生成流程，能直接补齐你对tool-use风险的盲区。
